name: Comments
description: Comments on the instance, each a reply to another or not. A caller who may write the instance adds one; a caller who may read it lists them. Deleting the instance deletes its comments.

fields.name: commentCount
fields.description: How many comments the instance has.

operations.name: comment
operations.description: Adds a comment to the instance, or a reply to one of its comments.

replyTo.description: The id of the instance's comment this one replies to.

id.description: The comment's number on the instance: 1, 2, 3, ...

replyTo.description: The id of the comment it replies to.

createdBy.description: The subject of the caller who added it.

operations.name: listComments
operations.description: Lists the instance's comments, oldest first, one page at a time.

limit.description: At most this many comments; 50 when absent.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.
